custom_preconds:
A custom role exists that is clock-capable but lacks the timesheetsView permission (built via the custom-role API harness).
A staff user is assigned that role and confirmed.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the clock-capable, non-timesheetsView user
custom_steps_separated.expected: Lands on a permitted page; the profile menu is reachable.
The My Timesheets item (profile_menu_timesheets) is visible.
The app navigates to /timesheets (route Timesheets) without bouncing to login or an unauthorized page.

custom_steps_separated.content: Switch to a mobile viewport and open the mobile menu
custom_steps_separated.expected: The My Timesheets item (mobile_menu_timesheets) is visible.

title: Clock-capable role without timesheetsView can see and open My Timesheets
